directionsTap: Taɓa harafin farko na kalma, sannan harafinta na ƙarshe. Ana ba kalmomin da aka samu lamba a cikin grid kuma ana ƙetare su a jeri.
directionsAcrossDown: Kalmomi suna tafiya a kwance ko a tsaye.
directionsDiagonal: Kalmomi suna tafiya a kwance, a tsaye ko a karkace.
directionsBackwards: An rubuta wasu kalmomi a baya.
directionsKeyboard: Da madannai: motsa da maɓallan kibiya, danna Enter ko Space a kan harafin farko sannan kuma a kan harafin ƙarshe. Escape yana share harafin farko.
startAt: An fara daga {letter}, layi {row} ginshiƙi {column}. Yanzu zaɓi harafin ƙarshe.
empty: Ƙara kalmomi don yin wasan wasa.
unplaced: Waɗannan kalmomi ba su dace a cikin grid ba kuma an bar su:
editing: An dakatar da wasa yayin da kake gyarawa.
